Hi Samantha — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today’s discovery and proposed next steps: 

- Use case: Customer support triage + summary for top 50% of cases (pilot scope = ~5000 tickets/month)
- Success metric: 30% reduction in avg. triage time + maintain >= 95% quality on summaries
- Timeline we discussed: pilot start in April, 4-week pilot, then expansion decision in May

Next steps for both sides: 
1) Redwood: share pilot SOW + initial contract (I’ll attach a draft to route to your procurement/legal) — target EOD Fri
2) ACME: confirm internal approvers and expected procurement timeline
3) Schedule kickoff once contract is signed (Jonas to coordinate dates)

If this matches your understanding, I’ll send the draft contract and loop in our legal for redlines. Appreciate confirmation on who I should send the redlines to (procurement or external counsel).

Thanks —
